prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original Daoist chibi game head ornament 407, Xia-jiao Deer Spirit (霞角鹿灵), high definition hand-painted transparent sprite phase atlas A.
Reference roles: Image 1 is ORIGINAL CLIENT STRUCTURE ONLY, labeled phases 0,1,2,4,5; use its right-facing profile, compact head silhouette and subtle eye/nose phase differences; never copy its orange ball face or red nose. Image 2 is our ORIGINAL character identity: cocoa brown spotted fawn, cream muzzle and ear interiors, dark small nose, large amber-brown eyes, translucent lavender-apricot short branched crystal antlers, short indigo neck scarf. Image 3 is our original inventory head version, keep identity and head-only crop. Images 4 and 5 are the established Daoist Q HD hand-painted style, jade/ivory/warm gold accents and gentle fine painted edges; do not include the UI, text or background.
Create exactly FIVE independent coherent drawings on a genuinely transparent 1536x1024 atlas, regular 3 columns x 2 rows of 512x512. Row-major occupied cells correspond exactly to source indices [0,1,2,4,5]; bottom-right cell entirely transparent. No labels or cell borders.
Each drawing is the same HEAD ONLY with very short scarf edge, no body, feet, wings, halo, sparkles, surrounding props or shadow. All heads face screen RIGHT in a nearly side profile matching image1. Keep the entire antlers, ears, muzzle and short scarf within a compact tall silhouette, occupied alpha bounding box close to width315 height345 (width/height=21/23=0.913, within5%), centered in its cell with generous transparent margins. Do not make the ears spread wide like a front view. No limb or body below the cheek.
Phases 0,1,2: subtly different open eye/muzzle highlights and nose profile, all same individual and same head scale. Phases4,5 have a slightly narrower visible muzzle/nose profile as in source; preserve cocoa/cream/dark-nose identity, not red nose. Keep stable antlers, scarf, ear arrangement and baseline; source vertical offsets will be applied separately later, do not bake extra up/down displacement into artwork.
Finish: polished high detail original 2D hand-painted game art, rounded cute head, clear mobile-size facial landmarks, soft fur indication, crisp translucent crystal planes, restrained thin warm gold on scarf charm. Consistent lighting and palette across all5 phases. Actual alpha transparency, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no text, watermark or decorative frame.
